posts.meta_description:
69K likes, 528 comments - karaandnate on January 29, 2023: "January 2020 🖤 This night will forever feel like a dream to me. I always describe it as the best night of my life. The people we met that night left a permanent imprint on my heart. I think about this night ALL the time. 

We spent 4 years traveling to 100 countries. After we reached our goal, we found ourselves here in Nashville with a million YouTube subscribers.

But when we first left home, it was 0.

Those 4 years were such a whirlwind. So by the time we landed back in Tennessee at this party, I don’t think we had even processed all we had gone through. (Which is why I cried happy tears all night 🙃)

We got to celebrate with over 700 of our biggest cheerleaders. And it was the first time I physically got to experience just how much love we are surrounded by. It was surreal. 

After this night, we had ZERO plan for what was next with our lives.

Turns out…it was a pandemic. But this night, we had no idea that was coming. Then right after, everything changed. Which is kinda why it feels even more like a dream. 

It’s been 3 whole years since our party 🤯 SO much has changed! But we are more grateful than EVER to be back in action, traveling the world, and still surrounded by so much love!!! The fact that we are still doing this thing is so darn cool. 

If you were at our 100 country party, in case I didn’t get to tell you in real life, thank you, and I love you 🥹🫶🏻 

Also, huge shoutout to @heathandalyssa for basically being the only reason this night actually happened 😁 Y’all are the best. 

PS making goals is so fun because then you get to celebrate when you reach them. What should our next goal be??? I’m ready for another party 🥳💃🏻".

posts.meta_description:
104K likes, 575 comments - karaandnate on December 7, 2022: "Everyone loved my $40 dress from Target, no one noticed that Nate repeated his same outfit from 4 years ago, and we finally got some photos taken of us that aren’t selfies! I’d consider that a win 🏆 

In all seriousness though :) We are so honored to have been nominated and a part of this event, and beyond thankful for the community that got us here! Times like these are a fun opportunity to look back at where we started back in 2016 - broke newlyweds with no idea what we were doing. Never thought this journey would lead us here 7 years later! Even though I still feel like we’re making it up as we go ;) 

Love y’all 🫶🏻❤️".

posts.meta_description:
224K likes, 3,631 comments - karaandnate on August 28, 2026: "Secret’s out! 🤭🤰🏻Can you believe it????

I spent my entire first trimester on the Mongol Rally 🤣 And I honestly wouldn’t change it. I was 8 weeks along when we arrived in Tbilisi, Georgia, and so we paid $30 to get an ultrasound. They allowed ALL 9 OF US to be in the room together for the most shocking, magical, emotional, beautiful experience of my life! Getting to see an actual baby with a beating heart inside of me for the first time - the little thing that had been making me nauseas, vomit, hormonal, bloated, excited, and terrified all at the same time - was actually REAL. I am in love with this feeling and don’t think I can ever get over it. And getting to share that experience with a room full of people I love so much was a dream I didn’t even know I had. 

Just WOW! Thank you to everyone who watched our announcement video - I can FEEL all of your love and joy to my core! Nate and I are so grateful. This week has been indescribable. Thank you thank you thank you 🥹💛".

35K likes, 556 comments - karaandnate on July 23, 2026: "Mongol Rally days 1 through 10 🚌 Big Bertha has now driven across 8 countries! We’ve been dreaming of this trip since January, and so far it’s lived up to all the hype. 

Failed border crossings (see pic #8😂) sunflower fields, bus raves, bear sightings, waterfalls, swims, mud baths…Loving all the chaos with the fam! 💛 

Scroll to the end to see the stats we’re keeping tally of! 

📍Colorado, USA to: Germany, Czech Republic, Slovakia, Hungary, Romania, Moldova, & Bulgaria 🫶🏼 

@mongolrallyofficial about 35 days to go!".

38K likes, 449 comments - karaandnate on July 6, 2026: "Our team had to have an INTERVENTION with Nate!!! 🤯 I have never seen him in the physical and emotional state he got to during @dead_cow_gully. Even though this was his 5th ultra, the “last man standing” format mentally challenged him like never before.

If you haven’t seen our doc on YouTube yet, or if you feel like you’ve seen one race you’ve seen them all, just know this one hits different.

Massive thank you for all the love we’ve received already!!! I haven’t been able to stop reading the comments section 🥹".

39K likes, 467 comments - karaandnate on April 11, 2026: "After ➡️ before ➡️ finish line!! 🎉 
Nate made a goal in 2026 to run 100 miles on all 7 continents, and South America was #4!! 🙌🏼 🇦🇷

He finished 87th out of 600, and went harder and faster than ever before. He pushed himself to a find new limit he didn’t know he had. I could see it and feel it every time I saw him along the way. As always I’m in awe of him ❤️

And how does he look the same after running up and down mountains for 31 hours?? 😍

Now to hobble him to bed with some pizza and pain relievers 😅 Thank you for all the love and support the last few days! Love ya! 

@patagonia_run 🩵🩵🩵".
